title: Low Volume Methodology for Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep Kit
author: Eric Adams
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be6rjhd6
materials: Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep Kit

Equilibrate the following reagents at Room temperature for 00:30:00 Bead-Linked Transposomes (BLT) Tagmentation Buffer (TB1) Tagment Stop Buffer (TSB) Tagment Wash Buffer (TWB) Sample Purification Beads (SPB)
Thaw KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X) On ice
Air-dry beads on the magnetic stand for 00:05:00

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare and thaw all necessary reagents to the required concentrations and temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Resuspension Buffer (RSB) to room temperature and vortex to mix.
Prepare proteinase K solution (300 μg/mL) by adding 15 μL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K to 985 μL of nuclease-free water.
Thaw i5 and i7 indexes at room temperature; vortex and spin down tubes, or spin down plates at 1500 rpm. Dilute index stocks to 10 μM working stocks.
Prepare Tagmentation Master Mix (TMM) containing 1 μL BLT and 1 μL TB1 per reaction (vortex BLT vigorously before use).

steps.title: Prepare PCR and SPB Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mixes for PCR and SPB cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR Master Mix (PCR MM) on ice: 2.75 μL nuclease-free water, 0.5 μL KAPA-PCR-F primer (10 μM), 0.5 μL KAPA-PCR-R primer (10 μM), and 6.25 μL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X) per reaction.
Prepare diluted SPB Master Mix (SPB MM): 54 μL SPB + 48 μL nuclease-free water.
Prepare a 110X mix: 110 μL TB1 + 110 μL BLT; vortex to mix.
Prepare a 110X mix: 302.5 μL nuclease-free water + 55 μL KAPA-PCR-F + 55 μL KAPA-PCR-R + 687.5 μL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2X); vortex and briefly spin down.

steps.title: Prepare Genomic DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Load and normalize genomic DNA into a 96-well PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer at least 100 ng (up to 500 ng) of genomic DNA into each well of a 96-well PCR plate in 1-5 μL.
Adjust the volume of each well to a total of 5 μL using nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Perform Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Tagment the DNA using the TMM and thermal cycler programs.

substeps.instruction: Load 27 μL TMM into 8-strip PCR tubes; vortex thoroughly to ensure beads are suspended.
Add 2 μL TMM to each well using an 8-channel pipette and mix by gentle pipetting (centrifuge briefly if beads adhere to walls).
Seal the plate and run the TAGflex program in a thermal cycler.
Load 15 μL TSB per tube into 8-strip PCR tubes.
Remove plate seal and add 1 μL TSB to each reaction; mix by gentle pipetting to resuspend beads.
Seal the plate and run the TAGstop program in a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Wash Tagmented DNA
steps.instruction: Clean the tagmented DNA using a magnetic stand and TWB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate on a 96-well magnetic plate stand for 3 minutes or until the solution is clear.
Carefully remove the supernatant with an 8-channel pipette without disturbing the beads.
Load 6 mL TWB into a sterile trough.
Remove plate from stand and add 20 μL TWB to each well; mix by gentle pipetting to resuspend beads.
Place the plate on the magnetic stand for 3 minutes or until clear.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Repeat the TWB wash (adding 20 μL TWB, mixing, and clearing on the magnet) one more time for a total of 2 washes.
Add 20 μL TWB to each well and gently pipette to resuspend beads.
Seal the plate and store on the magnetic stand until the next section to prevent over-drying.

steps.title: Perform Index PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the libraries and add dual indexes.

substeps.instruction: Load 135 μL PCR MM per tube into 8-strip PCR tubes and store on ice.
Carefully remove TWB supernatant from samples while on the magnetic stand.
Remove the plate from the magnetic stand and immediately add 10 μL PCR MM to each sample; pipette with moderate force to resuspend beads.
Seal the plate and spin down briefly up to 1000 rpm.
Add 2.5 μL of an equimolar mix of i7 and i5 indexes to respective wells (either 1.25 μL i7 + 1.25 μL i5 from tubes, or 2.5 μL from a pre-mixed plate).
Pipette to mix at least 10 times, seal, and spin down to 1000 rpm.
Run the flexPCR program in a thermal cycler.
Remove the plate and spin down for 1 minute at 280 x g.

steps.title: Bead Removal and Pooling
steps.instruction: Remove beads using proteinase K and pool the resulting libraries.

substeps.instruction: Load 35 μL of 300 μg/mL proteinase K per tube into 8-strip PCR tubes.
Remove plate seal and add 2.5 μL proteinase K to each reaction; mix by pipetting 10 μL volume at least 10 times.
Seal the plate and run the protK program in a thermal cycler (optional: store sealed at 4°C for up to 3 days).
Place the plate on the magnetic stand for 5 minutes or until the supernatant is clear.
Transfer 2 μL PCR supernatant from each well into 8-strip PCR tubes.
Transfer all samples from the 8-strip tubes into a single 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (approx. 192 μL total pooled library).
Vortex and briefly spin down to mix.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform SPB cleanup and ethanol washes on the pooled library.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a 45 μL aliquot of pooled libraries to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Vortex and invert SPB MM, then add 85 μL SPB MM to the library aliquot; pipette until thoroughly mixed.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 120 μL supernatant into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Vortex and invert undiluted SPB stock, then add 14.4 μL undiluted SPB to the supernatant; pipette 120 μL volume until mixed.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes or until clear; remove and discard supernatant.
While on the magnetic stand, add 200 μL 80% ethanol (ensure beads are submerged) without mixing; incubate for 30 seconds.
Pipette to remove ethanol without disturbing beads; repeat for a total of 2 washes.
Remove any excess liquid using a pipette.

steps.title: Library Elution and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Elute the final library and quantify the results.

substeps.instruction: Warm 35 μL RSB to 50 °C.
Remove the tube from the magnetic stand and add 32 μL warm RSB to the beads; pipette until resuspended.
Incubate on the bench at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place tube on the magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 30 μL supernatant into a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Incubate the eluted library at 50 °C for 5 minutes to ensure complete dissolution.
Quantify the library using a Qubit fluorometer and determine fragment size distribution using a Bioanalyzer.
